$comment: UnDesigned brand settings. Edit, then run `npm run build`. Each foundation (color, and later typography, layout) has its own section.

color.$comment: Brand palettes by combination number (1-348) from Sanzo Wada's A Dictionary of Color Combinations. Browse them in dist/brand-hub/index.html (Colour tab). "primary" becomes the default (--ud-bg, --ud-ink, --ud-accent ...). mode "light" puts the lightest colour in the background, "dark" the darkest.
